consequence.remediation: Re-write all ImageUpdateAutomation objects and update status.storedVersions on the CRD.

original.statement: Storage version of `imageupdateautomations.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io` changes v1beta2 → v1

consequence.statement: Existing ImageUpdateAutomation objects stay stored as v1beta2 and keep working in this release. They will need a storage version migration before a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: Before a later release removes v1beta2, re-write all ImageUpdateAutomation objects so they are stored as v1, then update status.storedVersions on the CRD.

corrected.statement: The storage version of imageupdateautomations.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io changes from v1beta2 to v1. Existing v1beta2 objects keep working and stay stored as v1beta2. They must be re-written and status.storedVersions updated before a later release removes v1beta2.

decision.reason: The evidence is just the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install manifests [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2], which back a computed storage-version diff. Nothing in them says that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated in this release. The change text itself says existing objects simply stay stored as v1beta2, which still works. Migration only becomes necessary before a later release removes v1beta2, so this is a deprecation (review), not migration-required (mandatory work).
